response.sql:
WITH joined_data AS (
  SELECT
    u.acctscope,
    o.recordvault
  FROM riskandmargin ram
  INNER JOIN orders o ON ram.ordervault = o.recordvault
  INNER JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp
),
scope_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    acctscope,
    COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) as order_count
  FROM joined_data
  GROUP BY acctscope
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(order_count) as total_orders,
    CAST(SUM(order_count) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) as avg_orders
  FROM scope_counts
)
SELECT 
  sc.acctscope,
  sc.order_count,
  CAST(sc.order_count AS REAL) / gs.total_orders,
  CAST(sc.order_count AS REAL) / gs.avg_orders
FROM scope_counts sc, global_stats gs
ORDER BY sc.acctscope;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in users.acctscope are treated as a distinct scope group. The schema permits NULL but documents four enum values (Margin, Spot, Options, Futures); if intent is to exclude NULL, add WHERE u.acctscope IS NOT NULL to the first CTE.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude NULL scopes and only analyze the four documented account-scope values.
